title: fix(app-shell): inside a package's second app, the sidebar and nav:menu links stay in that app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTegR38X4FfcBaaoy3Z2DJy)_

Fixes #29328

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6577088246).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：侧边栏的导航链接、侧边栏按路由选区（area）时读的路径前缀，以及 `nav:menu` 页面块的链接前缀，改为用应用自己的地址 `appAddressSegment`（在完整应用元数据列表中求值）：包 ID 能回到这个应用时用包 ID，否则用应用名。
- 为什么改：`/apps/包ID` 总是打开该包的第一个应用。一个包里有两个应用（例如 `crm` 与 `crm_service`）时，在第二个应用里点侧边栏任何一项，都会跳进第一个应用，换成别的应用的导航、顶栏和首页。#29024 已经修了头像菜单、⌘K、应用切换器、首页磁贴和报表索引，侧边栏还是旧算法。
- 风险与回滚：只改链接前缀的计算；包内第一个或唯一应用的链接逐字节不变（测试钉住了这两种对照）。`appAddressSegment` 是 `AppContent` 已在用的现有函数，不新增导出。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` 的两处 `basePath`（`areaRoute` 与导航）；`views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx` 的 `basePath`；新测试 `UnifiedSidebar.packageAppAddress-29328.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.packageAppAddress-29328.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/nav-menu.packageAppAddress-29328.render.test.tsx`，预期 7 个用例通过（在 main 上其中 3 个第二应用用例为红）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Sidebar** (`layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`): the nav `basePath` every entry link is built on, and the `basePath` of the route the area election reads, are `/apps/` plus `appAddressSegment(apps, activeApp)` over the full metadata app list (the list `AppContent` resolves `/apps/SEGMENT` on), instead of `appRouteSegment(activeApp)`, the package id. Inside a package's second app the area holding the routed entry is now elected too: with the package-id prefix no entry of the second app matched the route.
- **`nav:menu` block** (`views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx`): its `basePath` is built the same way.
- Both import `appAddressSegment` from `utils/appRoute.js`, as `AppContent` and `CommandPalette` do; the `utils` barrel does not re-export it, and the sidebar tests that mock the barrel keep working unchanged.
- A package's first or only app keeps its package-id links byte for byte.

## Tests

- `layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.packageAppAddress-29328.test.tsx`, through the real `UnifiedSidebar`, `NavigationRenderer` and route helpers (the `utils` module is not mocked): `com.example.crm` ships `crm` (first) and `crm_service` (two areas); `com.example.hr` ships `hr` alone. Inside `crm_service` an entry links to `/apps/crm_service/crm_queue`; at `/apps/crm_service/crm_case` the Casework area is elected and its object and dashboard entries link into `crm_service`. Controls: `crm` keeps `/apps/com.example.crm/...`, `hr` keeps `/apps/com.example.hr/...`.
- `views/__tests__/nav-menu.packageAppAddress-29328.render.test.tsx`, through the real `nav:menu` block under `SchemaRenderer` and `MePermissionsProvider`: inside `crm_service` its object and dashboard links carry `/apps/crm_service/...`; the same two controls.
- Red on main: both files run against `origin/main` `2f7977cd` before the fix: 3 failed (the three second-app cases; received `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_queue`, `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_case` and the first area elected), 4 passed (the controls).

## Acceptance notes

- Real browser: NOT MEASURED. No two-app package was staged on a running Console; the jsdom tests above go through the real sidebar and block.
- Noted by the card, not measured here and not changed: other `appRouteSegment(app)` link builders (AppSwitcher's setup path, the marketplace deploy button, ConsoleShell's setup alias).
